route_note: Take a direct TER train from Nice-Ville to Cannes-La Bocca or Cannes station, about 35 to 45 minutes, then walk to the seafront Croisette.

route_note: Take a regular TER train from Nice-Ville toward Ventimiglia; it takes about 35 to 45 minutes to Menton station, then a short walk up to the old town and basilica.
